info.name: CoffeeNChill - Part 2
info.description: HTTP endpoint tests for the CoffeeNChill Azure Functions: Menu Items (Azure Table Storage), Staff Documents (Azure Blob Storage) and asynchronous Orders (Azure Storage Queue + Orders table). Select the CoffeeNChill - Local environment and run the folders top to bottom.

request.description: Staff move the custom order straight to Collected. The queue processor detects the newer status and skips the remaining stages.
Re-using an OrderId that already exists in the Orders table is rejected with 409 Conflict.
Status can only move forward through the lifecycle, so moving a Collected order back to Preparing returns 409.
